name: disclosure
title: disclosure family
description: The expand/collapse family — trigger, panel, content. Zero variants. trigger is the toggle button (group for chevron rotation, w-full, justify-between, logical padding, hover on soft, focus ring). panel is the animated container (overflow-hidden, data-starting-style/data-ending-style fade). content is the inner padded content (p-4 pt-0). Shared by accordion and collapsible.
